registry_title: AgriSaarthi Master Government Agricultural Data Registry
provenance_categories: Third-Party Datasets Derived from Government Data

datasets.dataset_name: National Soil Health Card District Benchmarks
datasets.department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (DAC&FW), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
datasets.license: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) Open Access
datasets.processing_method: Cleaned missing values, standardized district spellings, mapped 12 macro and micro nutrients (N, P, K, pH, OC, S, Zn, Fe, B, Cu, Mn).
datasets.reliability_limitations: District-level statistical benchmark. Represents regional soil profile; does not replace mandatory laboratory testing of individual farmer's plot.

datasets.dataset_name: Sujala-III Land Resource Inventory (LRI) Soil Benchmarks
datasets.department: Watershed Development Department, Government of Karnataka & World Bank
datasets.geographic_coverage: Karnataka Selected Catchments (Raichur, Kalaburagi, Belagavi, Mysuru, Ballari, Vijayapura, Dharwad)
datasets.license: Government of Karnataka Public Research Publication
datasets.processing_method: Extracted available water capacity (AWC), textural class, soil order (Vertisol/Alfisol), and nutrient deficiency patterns.
datasets.reliability_limitations: Cadastral LRI surveys cover specific watersheds; extrapolated to district agro-climatic zones where village-level LRI is pending.

datasets.department: Directorate of Economics and Statistics (DES), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
datasets.processing_method: Aggregated major Kharif, Rabi, and Summer crop yields and production areas across 30 historical Karnataka districts.
datasets.reliability_limitations: Historical trend analysis only. Does not reflect current market price or unseasonal climatic shocks.

datasets.department: India Meteorological Department (IMD) & Karnataka State Natural Disaster Monitoring Centre (KSNDMC)
datasets.collection_period: Long-period historical normals (1981 - 2020 climatological normal series)
datasets.processing_method: Standardized annual and seasonal normal rainfall totals (Kharif, Rabi, Summer, Winter) in mm.
datasets.reliability_limitations: Represents 30-year climatological normal averages; actual seasonal rainfall fluctuates based on El Niño/La Niña.

datasets.dataset_name: Package of Practices for High-Yielding Crops
datasets.department: University of Agricultural Sciences, Raichur (UAS Raichur), UAS Dharwad, UAS Bangalore & ICAR
datasets.geographic_coverage: Karnataka Agro-Climatic Zones (North-Eastern Dry Zone, Northern Transition Zone, Southern Transition Zone)
datasets.file_format: JSON / Official Package of Practices Manual
datasets.processing_method: Digitized official NPK nutrient recommendations, commercial product bag conversions (50kg bags of DAP, Urea, MOP), and stage split timings.
datasets.reliability_limitations: Assumes standard medium soil fertility. Requires adjustment if farmer's soil test report indicates extreme high/low indices.

datasets.department: ICAR - Indian Institute of Water Management (IIWM) & Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO)
datasets.license: Public Scientific Citation & Agronomic Advisory Reference
datasets.processing_method: Compiled stage-wise crop coefficients (Kc: initial, mid, late), total seasonal water requirements (mm), and critical stress stages.
datasets.reliability_limitations: Calculations combine theoretical Kc with live meteorological temperature/rainfall. Does not measure subterranean moisture unless physical sensor is installed.

datasets.dataset_name: Integrated Pest & Disease Management Advisory & CIBRC Registry
datasets.department: ICAR - National Institute of Plant Biotechnology (NIPB), Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine and Storage (DPPQS) & Central Insecticides Board (CIBRC)
datasets.processing_method: Mapped symptoms, biological biocontrol agents (Trichoderma, Pseudomonas), and approved chemical fungicides to MobileNetV2 classes.
datasets.reliability_limitations: Screening is computer vision prediction; chemical pesticides should only be sprayed after physical confirmation by farmer or extension officer.

datasets.dataset_name: Official Central & Karnataka Government Agricultural Schemes Catalog
datasets.department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (myScheme.gov.in) & Karnataka Department of Agriculture
datasets.processing_method: Extracted eligibility criteria, financial benefit tiers, required documents, and verified application portals.
datasets.reliability_limitations: AgriSaarthi displays guidelines; final grant and subsidy disbursements rest entirely with government departments and verified FRUITS FID validation.

datasets.dataset_name: Raitha Samparka Kendra & KVK Public Agricultural Directory
datasets.department: Karnataka Department of Agriculture & ICAR Agricultural Technology Application Research Institute (ATARI)
datasets.geographic_coverage: Karnataka Districts (Raichur, Kalaburagi, Belagavi, Mysuru, Bengaluru, etc.)
datasets.processing_method: Compiled official landlines, mobile contact desks, office timings, and Google Map directions links.
datasets.reliability_limitations: Staff transfers and line maintenance may cause temporary unavailability of landlines. Kisan Call Center (1800-180-1551) provided as backup.

datasets.dataset_name: Karnataka District-Wise Crop Yield Benchmarks and UAS Package of Practices Targets
datasets.department: Directorate of Economics and Statistics (DES), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare & UAS Raichur
datasets.collection_period: Historical Census Series & UAS Package of Practices
datasets.processing_method: Derived district-level average historical yields (Quintals/Acre and Tonnes/Ha) and UAS Package of Practices (POP) potential yields across major crops.
datasets.reliability_limitations: Statistical district baseline. Actual farmer yield varies based on irrigation, pest incidence, and weather conditions.
